pools.title: Will a major lab ship a model with a 2M-token context window before October 31, 2026?
pools.description: Context length stopped being a marketing number the moment agent frameworks started depending on it. A public 2M window changes what can be built, not just what can be demoed.
pools.resolution: YES if a frontier lab makes a 2M-token (or larger) context window generally available through a documented API before the deadline. Waitlists and private previews resolve NO.

pools.resolution: YES if an autonomous agent is paid in stablecoins on Base for a task that a buyer accepts without human edit, with the settlement visible on-chain, before the deadline.

pools.title: Will inference prices for a frontier-class model fall another 30% before October 31, 2026?

pools.title: Will a zero-knowledge proof of an LLM inference be verified on a public chain before October 31, 2026?

pools.resolution: YES if a proof covering a full LLM inference step is verified by a deployed verifier contract on any public chain before the deadline, with the transaction publicly inspectable.

pools.title: Will any AI-agent framework exceed 100k monthly active developers before October 31, 2026?

pools.resolution: YES if a public package registry or the maintainer publishes a figure of 100,000+ monthly active developers for an agent framework before the deadline.

pools.title: Will this weekend's Premier League round produce 30 or more goals?

pools.resolution: YES if any team wins a Champions League match after trailing by two or more goals, within the next two matchdays.

pools.title: Will an esports grand final go to a deciding map this month?
